catalogPolicy.sameNamePolicy: Never merge addresses solely by normalized name. Prefer Sourcebook entry as the overview representative when it has a reliable source-plan district. List Core alternatives in search with their own source badge.
catalogPolicy.missingOverviewPointPolicy: Open its original source plan or district; say there is no registered overview coordinate. Do not silently scatter it at the district center.
catalogPolicy.coverageCaution: All outer-district NCS POIs currently lack overview coordinates, including the airport and container port. They still belong in search and district lists.

visibilityPolicy.start: Show named high-priority landmarks immediately, with category icon and short label; never gate all canonical pins behind zoom.
visibilityPolicy.crowding: At a whole-city fit, the central city is small. Use label collision handling and useful cluster click behavior rather than 40 overlapping names. Preserve high-priority icons even when their labels must collapse.
visibilityPolicy.zoom: At district zoom, expose lower-priority canonical points and names. A result click should zoom/focus its point and keep a readable selected label.
visibilityPolicy.selection: Use the POI card to explain what it is and why a player might go there, retaining page/source and approximate overview warning.

overviewReferenceProposals.validation: Name matches Playland By the Sea exactly; proposed point lies in G1. The G1 source-plan image has no number 3 marker, so retain approximate-reference wording.

overviewReferenceProposals.source: Draken unofficial overview + Sourcebook regional Airport symbol
overviewReferenceProposals.validation: Sourcebook region plan has Airport on the north shore of San Morro Bay in South Night City. Draken 95 is the city airport there; no 2077 airport identity or coordinates. Exact spelling alias is a deliberate editorial normalization.

registrationNotes: All 312 existing world points stay unchanged in v6. These proposals add missing sources only.
Use nine already recorded unregistered plan markers: four B2-plaza; E1#1/#3; F1#1; H1#1/#4.
H1#2 and H1#3 each appear twice on the plan. No new single-point anchor is supplied because one point would conceal the second site.
Draken Militech Training #58 lies in I1 while primary Militech training facility is J1. Do not use that Draken point: register the J1#4 source marker approximately within J1.
The 59 Mallplex interior entries share canonical parent ncs-b6-2; they can focus the parent overview point with basis parent-location, but must not be 59 separate overlapping map pins.
Named Totentanz has parent ncs-a3-7; Marksman/UrbanRanger have parent ncs-a1-5; MetropolitanBarbecue has parent ncs-a3-12. Use parent focus with an explicit interior-of-parent note.
Named ShortCircuit parent ncs-b4-13 lacks a world/source marker. Do not invent a new parent overview point.
Other unmapped central records have no current source marker. Keep searchable and open their source plans, rather than inventing positions.
